texts: Time is the hunter who grinds even stone to dust, and no creature escapes the patient hunger of its jaws
need a doha about Kaal chewing up everything, even a big stone doesn't survive it
stone, Kaal, devourer
Write a Kabir-style doha about Time as a ravenous hunter who devours everything in the world, kings and beggars alike, and wears down the hardest stone as if it were a morsel of bread
I went back to my old school and the heavy stone gate pillar I carved my name in is worn smooth; it felt like something big has been quietly eating everything while we weren't looking
My father's shop, his friends, his whole neighbourhood have been swallowed up by the years, and I feel like something huge is chewing through everything I ever knew; please put that into a doha
doha please about Kaal eating up the whole world, kings too
Kabir spoke of Kaal as a beast with an endless appetite that swallows the strong and the weak, the learned and the foolish, and I want a doha that captures that hunger in plain words
Kaal, the great eater
Hungry Time walks the earth with an open mouth, and every born thing is a morsel in its patient feast
The moneylender in our street kept his scales polished for forty years and counted every grain, and now the whole bazaar of his life has been devoured by passing years; I wish to put that in a doha
hey doha pls: Kaal as a hunter, with a moneylender and his scales, nobody escapes
Write a doha where Time the hunter weighs everyone on its scales and swallows them whole, even the moneylender who thought his wealth could buy him an exemption from the great devourer
scales, moneylender, Kaal hunts
The moneylender weighs his silver on the scales, yet hungry Time weighs him, and swallows the weigher and the weighed
bro, doha on Kaal the hunter who swallowed a snake and a touchstone, everything gets eaten
Please compose a doha in which Time devours the venomous snake and the proud touchstone alike, because the great hunter does not test his meal, he just eats whatever stands before him
The snake that struck so many and the touchstone that tested all are both a mouthful for the hunter called Time
I saw a snake skin and an old jeweller's touchstone in my grandfather's drawer after he passed, and it struck me that everything gets eaten by the years, even the dangerous and the precious
snake, touchstone, Time hunts
pls write a doha on Kaal swallowing a palanquin and a diamond like it's nothing
my cousin's wedding palanquin and the family diamond have both vanished into the years since the ancestral compound was sold, like some invisible beast swallowed them whole, can u make a doha
palanquin, diamond, Kaal feasts
The palanquin of the bride and the diamond of the king are both crumbs on the table of the hunter called Time
Kabir would say that Kaal chews through the raja's palanquin and the diamond in his crown with the same ease, so please write a doha about that merciless hunger which spares no splendour at all
Write a doha about the seed that is sown and the palanquin that carries the bridegroom, both swallowed in turn by the hungry hunter Time, who never leaves any feast unfinished
Seed and palanquin, bride and sower, all go into the endless mouth of Time that chews and never tires
hey doha about a seed and a palanquin, Kaal eats it all
my grandparents planted a seed they never got to see grow, and the palanquin they were carried in at their wedding rotted in a shed; something just ate those years away
seed, palanquin, Time devours
My whole family's old stories are fading and I realised nobody remembers my great-grandfather's name anymore; it is as if something has been eating the past from behind us while we walked on
a doha pls on how Kaal devours everyone
Kaal, devouring everyone
Hungry Time walks behind the children of the earth and swallows each footprint before the next is made
Please write a doha in the voice of Kabir telling me that Kaal is a hunter who has never been full, that nobody can bargain with his appetite, and that each of us is already on his plate
can u write a doha on a moth and Kaal, the great eater, he gets us all
moth, Time the hunter
The moth dances toward its end and hungry Time is waiting there, jaws open, for dancer and dance alike
a moth kept circling the bulb in my room last night and in the morning it was just a wing on the floor; I thought how greedy the years are, eating everything gentle and bright
Write a Kabir-like doha where a moth flutters carelessly while Kaal the hunter creeps closer, to remind us that the devourer is always watching and never misses the one who forgets him
doha pls: prayer beads, chakor bird, Kaal eats everything
prayer beads, chakor bird, Kaal
My grandfather's prayer beads are worn thin, and the chakor bird that used to visit his window has not returned; the years have eaten the whole scene
The prayer beads slip one by one into the mouth of Time, and the chakor bird that stares at the sky is swallowed too
Write a doha about Time the ravenous hunter who consumes the chakor bird gazing skyward and the old man with his prayer beads, pointing out that devotion alone does not make one safe from the feast
Please write a doha about the spinning wheel that Kaal turns as he feeds, turn by turn, devouring the people spun out of it, and none of them can resist the hunger of the great hunter
spinning wheel doha about Kaal swallowing everybody pls
spinning wheel, Kaal hunts
My aunt's spinning wheel sits dusty in the corner, and the whole generation that used it has been eaten by the passing years, one after another, like a quiet feast
The spinning wheel turns and turns, and hungry Time takes each spun life into his mouth without a word
My mother's ash-stained hands and a single pearl nose-ring are what remained of her when the years took the rest, as if something ate her slowly; please write a doha for me
ash, pearl, Time devours
Kabir would say that Kaal devours all things from the dazzling pearl to the humblest ash, and I want a doha that tells me the great hunter leaves nothing, not even a crumb, in the end
The pearl glows for a day and the ash lies cold forever, and both are eaten by the hunter who never sleeps
doha on pearl and ash and Kaal the eater
Even the green leaf is food for hungry Time, who eats the spring and the autumn without stopping
doha about Kaal eating a leaf and the whole world, keep it simple
leaf, Kaal the hunter
Write a Kabir-style doha where Time, a hunter with eternal hunger, nibbles on a single leaf and then on the entire world, to show us that no creature, large or small, can ever escape him
I swept the last leaf off my grandmother's porch today, and I could feel the passing years chewing at all of us; one by one they swallow everything

Please write a doha about Kaal, who sets out to hunt each morning and swallows kings, saints and fools without discrimination, so that nobody should feel that their name or wealth will save them from his table
can you write a doha on how Kaal eats everyone like a hunter
My whole village is empty now and the old people have gone; I feel like something with a terrible appetite crept in here over the years and finished everyone off
Time walks the earth with a hunter's patience and tastes the king and the pauper with the same cold hunger
Kaal eats all
Every friend I made in college is gone from my life, scattered like crumbs, and I have the feeling that something enormous is consuming the whole world slowly; can you write a doha about it
write a doha on Time the big eater, nobody gets away

Kabir called Kaal the one who eats the whole creation, who is never satisfied however much he swallows, so please compose a doha that makes the reader respect that merciless hunter and his endless appetite
Time, merciless eater
With a hunter's smile Time sits at the feast of the world, and every guest is also the meal
Hungry Time feeds on all that is born, and the feast has no last course
Hearing my grandfather list the names of friends he has outlived I felt like some creature was eating through his generation, one person at a time, and next it will be mine
Write a doha, in simple Kabir-like language, about Kaal who stalks every creature like a hunter in the evening and is never satisfied, so that we understand nobody can bargain with his appetite
Kaal, endless hunger
doha about the hunter Time eating everybody, thanks
a crow was pecking at the old ruins of my grandfather's courtyard today, and I thought how the years eat every home and every family like that, patiently and without hurry
doha about a crow and Kaal the great devourer please
The crow pecks at the remains while hungry Time waits behind, swallowing crow and carrion in a single bite
crow, Kaal the hunter
Please write a doha in which a crow caws over a ruined courtyard and Kaal sits behind it as the real feaster, devouring everything that grows, builds, or lives, to remind us of his hunger
Write a doha about the hunter called Time who has swallowed countless empires before us and will swallow ours too, and who never stops to ask whether the creature before him is a king or a child
I visited the ruins of a fort on a school trip and the guide said an emperor lived there once; it felt like something had slowly chewed up all his glory while the hills stood watching
Time has an open mouth and a patient heart, and every crown that ever shone is only a crumb in its mouth
Kaal, the great eater
a doha pls on Kaal who eats up emperors and everything else
Behind each birth walks hungry Time, pale and patient, with a hunter's knife and a feaster's smile
Kabir often said that Kaal sits waiting while we plan and build and boast, so please compose a doha in which the hunter's eyes follow every living being and his mouth is never full
doha on Kaal the hunter who eats all of us
my sister's whole generation of friends has moved away or passed on and our street feels eaten from inside; something has been swallowing people here slowly for years
Time, hungry hunter
leaf, mosque, Time hunts
The old mosque in my town lost its dome and a single leaf fell in the empty prayer hall today; I felt like something was eating the whole street, one building at a time
doha on Kaal swallowing a leaf and a mosque, pls
The mosque with its high arches and the leaf in its courtyard are both in the mouth of hungry Time
Please write a doha that shows Kaal, the hunter of all things, eating the green leaf as easily as the grand mosque, so that nobody mistakes the grand and lasting for something Time cannot swallow
Hungry Time devours the morning and the evening, the child and the elder, and has never once lost his appetite
Write a doha in which Time is a hunter who grows more hungry the more he eats, who has swallowed ancient kingdoms and will swallow the modern ones, and who does not hesitate before any creature
Kaal, hungry hunter
I found my father's old school photograph and nearly all those smiling boys are dead now; it seemed that a hidden beast had picked them off one by one over the decades
doha pls: Kaal as a hunter eating everyone
The musk deer runs through the cremation ground with fragrance in his own navel, yet Time the hunter takes deer and mourner in one bite
musk deer, cremation ground, Kaal
Write a doha where the musk deer wanders restlessly through the cremation ground seeking a scent, while Kaal the hunter follows quietly, ready to devour deer, seeker and every mourner there
Walking through the cremation ground with my father, I saw a musk deer skin framed on the wall of the caretaker's hut; everything here is eaten by the passing years, he said
hey doha: musk deer, cremation ground, Kaal eats everyone
My grandfather lost his whole orchard to the forest and the pot of water he kept at the gate dried up, as if something slow and hungry took the farm piece by piece; can you write a doha
forest, pot of water, Kaal
doha pls on Kaal and the forest and a pot of water, everything gets eaten
The forest swallows the path, the pot of water cracks, and behind them both Time the hunter smiles with a full mouth
Write a doha about Kaal as a hunter roaming the forest who needs no weapon beyond his appetite, and who swallows even the full pot of water at the wayside rest, because nothing is saved from him
musk deer, fly, Time hunts
a fly buzzed round my sleeping grandfather today, and I remembered the story of the musk deer he used to tell; it felt like the years eat every little creature the same way
The musk deer and the fly are both small morsels for the hunter Time, who tastes the swift and the slow alike
can u write a doha about a musk deer, a fly and Kaal the devourer
Please write a Kabir-like doha where Kaal hunts the musk deer in the thicket and the buzzing fly on the wall with equal ease, to remind us that nothing, great or tiny, has ever escaped his hunger
My grandmother always said that everything we build is borrowed from something that waits to eat it, and since she passed I feel that hunger in every old photograph we have
doha on Kaal swallowing the whole world pls
The world is a banquet laid by hungry Time, and he eats his guests without ever being full
Kaal, devourer
Write a doha in the voice of Kabir telling us that Time is a hunter who feeds on every living thing, that nobody escapes the table, and that wise people stay aware of his appetite
hey doha about touchstone and Kaal, even the touchstone gets eaten
touchstone, Time the hunter
Please write a doha in which the touchstone that tests metal is itself tested by Kaal the hunter, who swallows the tester and the tested with no pity and no pause, to remind us of the great appetite
my grandfather the old jeweller's touchstone is cracked and nobody in the family has his skill, as if the years chewed up not just him but everything he knew
The touchstone tests every metal, but hungry Time tests the touchstone and finds it quite edible
doha about a skeleton and Kaal the hunter, he eats everything
Write a Kabir-style doha about a skeleton lying where a proud man once stood, the leftovers of a meal that hungry Time swallowed long ago, as a reminder that this hunter finishes everything
skeleton, Time devours
At the medical college museum I looked at a skeleton and thought about how the years strip everyone down to that, like a hunter who leaves only the leftovers of a feast
The skeleton is only what hungry Time forgot on his plate, and soon he will return for it too
The shadow of Time falls on the philosopher's stone and even that miracle is devoured, for the hunter eats the myth and the magic
shadow, philosopher's stone, Kaal
doha plz, Kaal swallowing a shadow and a philosopher's stone, nobody escapes
My late uncle spent his life hunting for a philosopher's stone in old books, and when I stood by his empty chair in the evening shadow it felt like something hungry had taken him
Write a doha where Time the hunter follows every shadow and devours all things, including the legendary philosopher's stone that was supposed to defeat him, so that people learn nothing can stop him

Please write a doha in which Kaal is the one hunter who has never missed his prey, whether a king hiding behind his guards or a monk hiding in a cave, because every hiding place is already inside his mouth
Time the hunter eats the first light and the last, and the long road between is only the length of his meal
After the factory shut down, the town where my father worked slowly emptied out, homes first, then the schools, then the families; it felt like something huge was devouring it
Kaal, unseen devourer
doha on Kaal the hunter who gets everyone eventually
Kaal, hunter, eater
can u write a doha on Kaal the devourer of everything
Looking at my old college friends on social media I count how many have faded away already, and it feels like something is steadily picking through our whole batch
Please write a doha in the voice of Kabir telling us that Kaal eats up every ruler, every wise man and every beautiful face, and that no one has ever been strong enough to turn the hunter away
Behind the laughter of the young stands hungry Time, licking his lips with a patient smile
Hungry Time chews the palaces and the proud, and every dawn he sharpens his appetite again
Write a doha about Kaal who hunts all creatures from the cradle to the grave and swallows what he finds, and who asks no questions about caste, wealth, learning or the name of the one he eats
Time, the hungry hunter
When I tried to remember the name of my first teacher, I could not, and I felt that something had quietly swallowed even that; the years just eat whatever we hold dear
doha about Kaal eating everything, easy words
Kaal the hunter doha pls, he eats big and small
The hunter called Time has a bottomless appetite, and the young and the old are equally welcome at his table
my family's ancestral village is crumbling and the old caretakers who tended it are gone one by one; it feels like a hungry beast is eating the memory of that place
Compose a doha that describes Kaal as a hunter who never sleeps and never rests, feeding on every thing that is born and built, while mortals go about their lives pretending he is far away
Kaal, devouring appetite
bier, Kaal the hunter
I walked behind the bier of my neighbour yesterday and thought that something is eating this whole street one family at a time, quietly and patiently
Write a doha about how the hunter called Time carries a bier on its back for every creature it has caught, and how the most powerful and the humblest are laid on the same one in due course
The bier is only the plate on which hungry Time serves the creatures he has caught
doha on Kaal with a bier in it, the hunter eats everybody
Write a doha where Kaal is a hunter blowing out every lamp one after another, devouring the glow of each household in turn, so that people understand no flame in this world can outshine his appetite
lamp, Time hunts
can u write a doha on a lamp and Kaal the eater
Time breathes on the lamp as a hunter breathes on a trembling animal, and then takes what is left
The lamp in my grandmother's room went out the night she died, and I felt as if a patient beast had finally finished the meal it had been working on for years

Please write a doha where Kaal the hunter strolls through the market and the mirror shop alike, swallowing buyers and sellers and every reflection, so that no one believes the busy world is beyond his reach
In the market of the world and the mirror of vanity, hungry Time eats the merchant and the face in the glass
doha pls with a market, a mirror, and Kaal as the devourer
My uncle sold every kind of mirror in the old market for thirty years and now it is a parking lot; the years ate every face in it, and I would like a doha about that
market, mirror, Kaal hunts
doha about Kaal eating up all of us
Time the hunter lies in wait behind every smile, for he has a hunger that the whole world cannot fill
I looked at the old family chart my uncle drew and realised most of the names are crossed out; something has been working through us for generations without ever being full
Write a Kabir-style doha that portrays Time as a hungry hunter and a patient eater who has taken the earlier generations and now waits very near us, urging us to recognise his appetite
Time, patient hunter
heron, sandalwood, Kaal
doha pls: Kaal as hunter, with a heron and sandalwood, nobody escapes
At the pond I saw a heron stand statue-still while sandalwood scented the air, and it reminded me how the years stalk us all, patiently, and swallow us when we are not ready
The heron stalks its prey, but Time the hunter stalks the heron, and the sandalwood grove is only a larger meal
Please write a doha where Kaal hunts the heron that hunts, and the fragrant sandalwood stands unaware of the axe, so that we realise every hunter is also hunted by the one great devourer
bell doha pls, Kaal swallows even the sound of a bell
bell, Kaal the devourer
When the evening bell stopped ringing after the old caretaker died, I felt that the years had swallowed more than a man, they had swallowed a whole sound of my childhood
Write a doha about the bell that rings the hours, telling the passers-by that Time the hunter has taken one more share of life and is already coming back for the rest
Each stroke of the bell is a bite that hungry Time takes from the day, and the day does not complain
My grandmother's churn is still in the kitchen but nobody has made butter in twenty years; it seems like the years have been eating her whole world in small bites
can u write a doha on a churn and Kaal the hunter eating all
churn, Kaal hunts
The churn turns the cream of days, but hungry Time sits beside it and drinks the butter and the churner

Please write a doha where Kaal the hunter works the churn of the whole world as a woman does with buttermilk, taking the essence and swallowing the rest, so that no one imagines he will leave any life alone
a doha on a lion and Kaal who eats even lions
Our local zoo's old lion died last week and everyone was shocked that something so powerful could be taken; I felt that nothing is ever safe from the years
Write a doha that says the lion who rules the wild country is himself a morsel for Time, the great hunter who never roars but always arrives, and who swallows the brave as easily as the frightened
lion, Time the hunter
The lion roars at the whole valley, but Time the hunter does not roar, and in the end the lion is his meal
doha on a fly and Kaal who eats everything
A fly sat on my grandfather's tea cup the afternoon he died, and since then I feel that everything small and large is swallowed by something patient and huge
Compose a doha showing that the tiny fly and the great emperor are both eaten by the same hunter called Time, who has no favourites and makes no distinctions when he sits down at his table
The fly hums over the feast and does not know it is also a course in the banquet of hungry Time
fly, Kaal hunts
doha pls: bitter gourd and Kaal the eater
My mother grew a bitter gourd vine on the terrace for years and this year it didn't sprout; somehow I feel that everything she loved is being slowly devoured by the days
Sweet or bitter, Time the hunter tastes it all, and the bitter gourd on the vine is his meal like the king on the throne
bitter gourd, Kaal devours

Write a Kabir-style doha where Kaal the hunter eats even the bitter gourd that nobody wants, to teach that nothing the world rejects or loves escapes his teeth, and so we should not feel too proud of either

Please write a doha about the touchstone that judges coins and the people who judge others, both swallowed by Time the hunter, who comes to every judge in the end and tests them with his appetite alone
touchstone, Kaal hunts
My grandfather the assayer used his touchstone on coins all day, and on the day he died I felt that the years had weighed him and eaten him just like everything else
doha pls with a touchstone, about Kaal as the hunter who eats everything
The touchstone is worn by the coin it tests, and both are worn by Time, who eats the testers last
My neighbour's spinning wheel and the lock on her old trunk are all that is left of her belongings; the rest has been eaten by the years and the forgetting
Kaal the hunter doha with a spinning wheel and a lock, pls
spinning wheel, lock, Kaal
The lock holds the trunk and the spinning wheel holds the days, but hungry Time holds the hunter's key and the feast is his

Write a doha where the spinning wheel keeps spinning the days and the lock keeps guarding the treasure, yet Kaal the hunter walks through both and swallows whatever lies between the maker and the made
All the nine ages have fed hungry Time, and still he looks around the table and asks what else there is

Please write a doha that makes the reader feel the endless appetite of Time, who stalks like a hunter and swallows like a flood, and who has been feeding on the world since long before anyone was born
Kaal's endless hunger
can u write a doha about Time the hunter eating everyone and everything
When my grandfather's generation went one by one, I realised how little remains of any age, as if a very patient creature had been working down the whole table
The cleric calls the faithful to prayer, but hungry Time calls them first, and the faithful and the cleric both enter his mouth
Our village cleric who gave the call to prayer for forty years has died, and the whole place felt devoured by silence; it seems everything is being eaten slowly by the years
cleric, Kaal the hunter

Write a doha showing that even the cleric and the learned, who teach others about the end of the world, are swallowed by Kaal the hunter, who needs no sermon and takes the preacher as readily as the sinner
doha with a cleric in it and Kaal who eats us all
Time is a hunter of patient eyes and a mouth that has never been satisfied by anything the world has offered it
doha pls on the hunter called Kaal, who eats everybody

Please write a Kabir-style doha that warns how Time the hunter picks his prey calmly, chews the generations slowly, and is never in a hurry, because he knows that everyone eventually walks into his waiting mouth
Kaal, patient devourer
When I scroll through the old class photo I see how many faces have gone, and it feels like some quiet creature has been picking at us for years without ever being full
doha on Kaal the hunter who eats up the whole world, please
My grandfather sold his shop, his land and finally his old watch, and somehow it all disappeared into the years like it was swallowed by a beast we could not see
Time prowls the world with a quiet step and a deep hunger, and sooner or later we all become his dinner
Kaal, devouring Time

Please write a doha in the voice of Kabir that tells how the great hunter called Time has been eating since the first day of creation, has never been full, and will never leave a single creature uneaten
heron, Kaal the hunter
At dusk I watched a heron wait in the shallows without moving, and thought about how the years wait for each of us in just that way; then in one second it all vanishes
Write a doha that shows the heron stalking in the shallows and Kaal stalking behind, the hunter who hunts the hunters, so that the proud predator learns he is also on someone's plate
doha about Kaal the hunter and a heron, who eats whom
The heron stands in deceitful stillness, but Time the hunter stands behind him, stiller and hungrier
This place was once full of people, shops and noise, and now it is quiet and almost empty; the years just ate all of it without leaving anything behind
Silent Time moves like a hunter through the long grass of ages, and the villages and kingdoms vanish into his mouth
Time, silent hunter
Write a doha in the voice of Kabir that shows how Time keeps on devouring cities, families and generations without anger or pity, simply because it is his nature to eat
doha on Kaal the hunter devouring everything in sight
river, moth, Kaal
The river runs to the sea and the moth runs to the flame, and hungry Time the hunter waits at both ends with open arms
doha pls: river, moth, Kaal as the hunter who eats all

Please write a doha in which the river carries everything toward the great hunter Time and the moth hurries toward its own end, as if every creature were walking willingly to the table of the devourer
my grandfather's village was beside a river, and the moth-eaten shawl he left is all that remains of it, since the years devoured the rest of what he loved
